name: security-graphql-subscription-revocation-review
intent: GraphQL subscription entitlement after connection setup
artifacts: Subscription resolver, connection identity, event filtering, revocation hooks and owned event publisher.
trace: Trace authorization at subscribe time and each delivered event, including membership/session changes while the connection remains open.
experiment: Subscribe with an owned account, revoke its synthetic resource entitlement, then emit one inert event; compare a still-entitled subscriber.
disproof: An open connection is not itself unauthorized data delivery; buffered already-authorized events require timing evidence.
repair: Revalidate or terminate according to policy and retest revocation, reconnect and entitled event delivery.
branch_decisions: Record whether the contract requires immediate per-event reauthorization or bounded revocation propagation. Events queued before revocation need issuance/delivery timing. A still-open WebSocket without protected events is not continued access; separately test reconnect under the revoked identity.
